items.html: The general conclusion is that brain, heart, and liver, since they are the inner vessels of the body, and each one has in it three aspects: inner, middle, and outer, as is known — for even in the Ibur and Yenika the fetus has a brain, heart, and liver. But since they are more inner than all the body, there are clothed and revealed the essence of the NRN, because all three of them are in the middle line, which is the essence of the body, and from there they send their illumination in all the limbs, in this manner:
